newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran's Velayati arrives in Oman on regional tour.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Velayati arrives in Oman on regional tour.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati arrived in the Gulf state of Oman on Sunday, carrying an invitation for Oman's Sultan Qaboos to an Islamic summit in Tehran.

The Iranian minister, on a tour of 10 countries, is extending invitations to Moslem heads of state and government from President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani for the December meeting of the Moslem world's largest body, the Organisation of the Islamic Conference.
Velayati was due to meet Sultan Qaboos later on Sunday.

Speaking to reporters on his arrival from Saudi Arabia, the minister stressed the importance of cooperation among Gulf countries to promote security in the region, and emphasised Iran's opposition to Western military involvement.

"We think that the security of this sensitive region should be in the hands of its countries," Velayati said. "But this cannot be achieved without positive cooperaton among the countries of the region through the creation of a positive atmosphere on the basis of mutual understanding."

Iran has repeatedly condemned the U.S. military presence in the region, where U.S.-led forces enforce U.N. sanctions against Iraq. Iran says U.S. troops in the region, including about 5,000 in Saudi Arabia, increase regional tension.
Saudi Arabia and its Gulf allies have accused non-Arab Iran of interfering in their internal affairs, which Iran denies, and voice concern over Iran's arms build-up.
